episode_summary: In this episode, Brenton Miebach shares his journey of breaking into new real estate markets using paid leads and AI-driven systems. He discusses the importance of learning the market quickly and leveraging AI to replace traditional roles, enhancing efficiency. Brenton also reveals his successful social media strategy, focusing on historical storytelling to engage a mature audience on Facebook.
